subject: C23
required_fixes: C23-F1 (high): Bind Academy owner writes and rollback to the recorded account and generation. In authority/import_v1_domain/owners.rs:604-605, writing Drafts discards owner_digest and reacquires the currently signed-in learner, although intend checked the original owner earlier at :416-430. More directly, holds at :763-769 and revert at :850-862 ignore Written::Draft.account entirely. After importing for account A, signing in as B with the same attempt ID and draft content lets rollback of A's receipt delete B's draft. An account change between intend and write can also direct A's payload into B's store. Carry the expected account/generation through the owner operation and refuse stale or mismatched authority at commit. Acceptance: A's receipt must never read, overwrite or delete B's draft, even with identical attempt/content; exercise account changes between planning, intention, write and rollback.

C23-F2 (high): Make draft conflict checks and mutation one conditional owner operation. owners.rs:427 checks absence separately from the unconditional store.put at :623; a draft created or edited after that check is overwritten. Rollback similarly awaits holds at :787, then deletes by ID at :857 without rechecking the recorded content under the store's commit lock. A save between the check and delete loses newer user work. The cases/reports branches already recheck under their writer; drafts need equivalent conditional insertion/deletion with the account/generation fence. Acceptance: pause after each check, save a different draft through the normal editor, then continue import or rollback; the newer draft must remain intact and be reported as a conflict/kept change.

C23-F3 (high): Do not authorize owner writes from an unconfirmed receipt. receipt::store returns Unconfirmed when directory sync fails after rename (import_v1/receipt.rs:183-185), but import_v1_domain.rs:1031 treats that as success. write_items then performs owner writes after this unconfirmed writing note (:1186-1190); rollback likewise proceeds after an unconfirmed reverting note. Durable destination changes can therefore outlive the receipt needed to identify and reverse them. Require confirmed durable journal state before effects, and report/recover uncertain journal publication without claiming completion. Acceptance: inject receipt directory-sync failures at creation, writing and reverting; no new owner mutation may proceed without durable recovery metadata, and relaunch must retain an actionable, truthful receipt.

C23-F4 (high): Distinguish intended writes from changes actually owned by this import. write_items stores all intended identities in ReceiptItem.written before the owner write (:1179-1187). After an interruption there, resume treats matching current content as owned (:1173-1176), and rollback accepts Writing items and removes matching entries. If the app stops at Writing before adding a case, and the operator subsequently adds that same case independently, rollback deletes work the import never created. A matching content hash is not provenance. Bind owner commits to an import operation/generation marker, or reconcile ownership with equivalent durable evidence. Acceptance: interrupt before the case owner write, relaunch, independently add identical case content, then resume and roll back; that independently added case must remain and the receipt must not claim it.

C23-F5 (medium): Implement the selected atomic publication contract. DESIGN.md:2043-2051 requires staging a new v2 generation, atomic manifest commit, retention of the previous generation and no partially committed generation visible after interruption. The current write_items loop publishes each item directly through live owners (:1190); for example owners.rs:505-516 immediately saves and announces a new tenant before later categories complete. A receipt makes this resumable but does not provide atomic publication. D050's item journal does not implement the selected guarantee. Acceptance: interrupt after an early category and before a later category; normal destination views must retain the prior committed generation until the reviewed import commits atomically, with resume/rollback preserving preexisting and subsequently authored work.
evidence_gaps: C23-G1: Add deterministic production-interface tests for account changes during an import/rollback, a different signed-in account with identical draft IDs/content, and edits between draft check and mutation. academy_drafts_go_only_to_the_same_signed_in_account checks account mismatch before planning and rollback while still signed in as the original owner; it does not cover the failing transitions.

C23-G2: The commit-point suite selects tenants/cases/reports, and the one-shot interrupt hook stops at the first matching item, normally a tenant. It does not establish interruption safety for each category, writes within multi-record categories, journal write/sync failure, independent matching work appearing after Writing, or atomic generation visibility. Extend the failure matrix around those boundaries and verify durable receipts, destination ownership and pre/post visibility. The 19 mutation guards and current native flows do not establish these properties.
limitations: Independent read-only review. No source/application edits, build/test reruns, application launches, product endpoint calls or credential access. Findings follow inspected production control flow and state ownership; they are not claimed as newly executed runtime reproductions. Only the designated verdict artifact is written.

All four supplied fingerprints independently match at the beginning and end. Verified 718 inventory entries, 392 direct packet references, all recorded command logs/artifacts, shared dependency equivalence and exact C23 command plans. Direct C22 and P06 predecessors pass; 30 transitive receipt bindings match. Historical owner-accepted chunk attempts are retained as history rather than incorrectly required to have passed the later phase threshold.

Recorded evidence passes 13 check commands, 13 test/setup commands and 3 native-preparation commands. Logs include 413 desktop frontend and 219 core unit tests, 14 imports_rollback tests, 8 import module tests and the targeted owner regressions. Native evidence records all 8 C23 checks plus 250 C01-C22 regression checks against fixture executable 3f4aea2b025e19b601310e22bbe9128aafe6619d106b833a0a41e7bb4d0b2d97. The 19 named C23 mutation guards report failures under mutation, with four baseline targets passing three times each. These passing results do not resolve the causal defects above.

The read-only v1 source adapter, selected-category protected reads, metadata whitelist, missing capabilities on imported tenants and inspect-only conversation origin are useful implemented boundaries. Inspected pinned v1 settings and Academy storage source at 74754c02 for contract comparison; no real v1 profile or protected data was read. The fixtures demonstrate ordinary source-byte preservation and no synthetic product requests.

Native source data and Keychain items are staged fixtures; production login-Keychain access and real v1 profiles were not exercised. Crash hooks model selected process interruption points, not power-loss durability. Spoken VoiceOver and signed installed-package qualification remain separate gates. No C23 workload is registered; this review assesses its explicit size/count bounds rather than inventing a new performance gate.
